question: Where is Malaysian Grand Prix held? Give the location coordinates.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "malaysian_gp_circuit" AS SELECT DISTINCT
  r.year AS race_year,
  r.name AS race_name,
  c.circuitid AS circuit_id,
  c.circuitref AS circuit_ref,
  c.name AS circuit_name,
  c.location AS city,
  c.country AS country,
  c.lat AS latitude,
  c.lng AS longitude,
  c.url AS circuit_url,
  r.url AS race_url
FROM table_2 AS r
JOIN table_1 AS c
  ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid
WHERE r.name ILIKE '%Malaysian Grand Prix%'
   OR r.name ILIKE '%Malaysia Grand Prix%'

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "conductor_s_execution" AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    circuit_name,
    city,
    regexp_replace(country, '[^A-Za-z ]', '') AS country,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    race_year
  FROM malaysian_gp_circuit
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    circuit_name,
    city,
    country,
    ROUND(AVG(CAST(latitude AS DOUBLE)), 5) AS latitude,
    ROUND(AVG(CAST(longitude AS DOUBLE)), 5) AS longitude,
    MIN(race_year) AS first_year,
    MAX(race_year) AS last_year,
    COUNT(*) AS editions
  FROM base
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
)
SELECT circuit_name, city, country, latitude, longitude, first_year, last_year, editions
FROM agg
ORDER BY editions DESC, last_year DESC
LIMIT 1;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "conductor_s_execution" AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    circuit_name AS venue,
    city,
    REPLACE(REPLACE(country, '[', ''), ']', '') AS country,
    CAST(latitude AS DOUBLE) AS latitude,
    CAST(longitude AS DOUBLE) AS longitude,
    race_year
  FROM malaysian_gp_circuit
  WHERE circuit_name IS NOT NULL
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    venue,
    city,
    country,
    ROUND(AVG(latitude), 5) AS latitude,
    ROUND(AVG(longitude), 5) AS longitude,
    MIN(race_year) AS first_year,
    MAX(race_year) AS last_year,
    COUNT(*) AS editions
  FROM base
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
)
SELECT
  venue,
  city,
  country,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  CONCAT(CAST(latitude AS VARCHAR), ', ', CAST(longitude AS VARCHAR)) AS coordinates
FROM agg
ORDER BY editions DESC, last_year DESC
LIMIT 1;
